reason: Adds a NewAPI/OpenAI-compatible LLM provider to DeepSeek Harness, with model discovery, chat completion routing, credential-backed configuration, and a web settings page.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入兼容 OpenAI API 的 NewAPI 网关，支持模型发现、聊天请求转发以及网页设置配置。
summaries.en: Adds a NewAPI/OpenAI-compatible gateway provider to DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, chat requests, and web-based configuration.

capabilities: Connects to a configured NewAPI/OpenAI-compatible gateway over HTTP(S)
Discovers available models through a models endpoint
Sends chat-completion requests to the configured gateway
Stores and resolves an API credential through the host credentials service
Provides a web settings page for gateway and model configuration
